start.speaker: sera
start.text: You came up. Good. I have been standing here working out how to say a thing without it sounding like an order. I watch you in the line. Not the way I watch the line.

choices.text: Sera. Not like that. But I am glad it is you on my left.
Ask me again when we are not bleeding.

yes.speaker: sera
yes.text: Then we are both fools. Get some sleep. Tomorrow I will stand a little closer.

no.speaker: sera
no.text: Understood. That is not nothing. The left stays yours.
